scope: Initial Phase 2 research observations. These records are not a finalized resource library or a full literature review. Original source IDs and metadata are not overwritten.

records.title: OCC — Characteristics and Risks of Standardized Options
records.observation: The page identifies the June 2024 ODD and explains its replacement of older editions and the T+1-related update.
records.limitation: Landing-page verification does not establish a full PDF review, contract-specific procedures or broker deadlines.
records.next_step: Map the current PDF sections to contract/assignment competencies and check linked notices.

records.title: Federal Reserve — SR 26-2: Revised Guidance on Model Risk Management
records.observation: The April 17, 2026 letter explicitly supersedes SR 11-7 and SR 21-8. The inherited resource identity and supersession note are supported.
records.limitation: This is bank supervisory guidance; do not present its scope as a retail-trader legal obligation. The attached detailed guidance still needs review.
records.next_step: Select model-development, validation and governance readings from the attachment with exact scope.

records.title: SEBI — Trading Behaviour of Individual Traders in the Equity Derivatives Segment (FY25–FY26)
records.observation: The official landing page identifies the report and date August 20, 2026. Its PDF viewer exposed a linked attachment, but direct PDF retrieval returned an internal error.
records.limitation: No report statistics, population definitions or conclusions have been verified from the PDF.
records.next_step: Retrieve the report through an accessible official route, read methodology and reconcile it with earlier SEBI studies.

records.title: NSE — Equity Derivatives Contract Information
records.observation: The official directory links contract specifications, quantity freezes, permitted lot sizes and an introduction/exclusion tracker.
records.limitation: The linked daily files were not downloaded or reconciled in this pass. No current lot-size table is certified.
records.next_step: Design a dated instrument worksheet and verify exact contract versions against notices and daily files.

records.title: NSE — Securities Transaction Tax
records.observation: The page distinguishes rates before and from April 1, 2026, and separates option-sale premium from exercise intrinsic value as tax bases.
records.limitation: This observation is not a personalized tax determination or a complete statutory review. Rates have not been placed in application code.
records.next_step: Create source-backed, effective-dated fee/tax examples and reconcile primary legislation for the intended year.

records.title: FINRA — Rule 4210
records.observation: Paragraph (g) distinguishes portfolio margin from strategy-based margin and includes eligibility, monitoring and risk-analysis provisions.
records.limitation: Only relevant portfolio-margin portions were examined. Other paragraphs, amendment histories and broker overlays have not been fully reviewed.
records.next_step: Map selected requirements by account/product and verify operative amendment dates before authoring rules lessons.

records.title: QuantLib — Official Documentation
records.observation: The directory distinguishes the official reference manual from community Python documentation, author guides, notebooks and screencasts.
records.limitation: Linked videos have not been watched and example results have not been executed or independently validated.
records.next_step: Select exact calendar, vanilla-pricing and risk examples; identify library version and independent reference values.

records.title: OIC — Exercising Options
records.observation: A focused teaching candidate for holder instructions, clearing/member assignment, early exercise and expiry uncertainty.
records.limitation: US-style examples must not be generalized to every jurisdiction or exercise style.
records.next_step: Build original contrasting assignment cases and map the reading to exact competencies.

records.title: OIC — Options Strategies Quick Guide (2025)
records.observation: A concise structure-reference candidate was located, including terminology for ratio and synthetic positions.
records.limitation: The full PDF and its diagrams have not been reviewed. Structure descriptions cannot establish an expected trading edge.
records.next_step: Review each relevant strategy against signed-leg algebra and operational cases.

records.title: MIT OCW — 18.01SC Single Variable Calculus, Fall 2010
records.observation: The independent-learner course offers lectures, worked examples, problem sets and exam solutions, making it a candidate for the missing calculus bridge.
records.limitation: Specific lectures, exercises and study-time assignments have not been selected; linking does not grant blanket redistribution rights.
records.next_step: Map differentiation, integration and approximation skills to pricing/Greek entry competencies.

records.title: MIT OCW — 18.06 Linear Algebra, Spring 2010
records.observation: Gilbert Strang's course includes matrix systems, eigenvalues and positive definite matrices, with lectures, assignments and exams.
records.limitation: The entire course is not automatically a prerequisite for beginner options study.
records.next_step: Select only required entry material, with deeper PCA/covariance preparation for quantitative paths.

records.title: NumPy — Absolute Basics for Beginners
records.observation: Array shape, types, indexing and views provide a concrete foundation for payoff grids and vectorized numerical work.
records.limitation: A generic array tutorial does not teach financial units, time alignment or pricing semantics.
records.next_step: Author a payoff-array exercise and a copies/views error case using a pinned teaching environment.

records.title: SciPy — Optimization and Root Finding
records.observation: The root_scalar reference exposes bracketed and derivative-based methods suitable for comparing numerical inversion behavior.
records.limitation: Solver availability does not ensure a valid IV solution; option price bounds, model and conditioning must be checked separately.
records.next_step: Assign Brent/bisection/Newton comparisons including zero-vega and invalid-price cases.

records.title: statsmodels — Time Series Analysis
records.observation: The documentation covers autoregression, ARIMA and state-space estimation and forecasting.
records.limitation: This is an implementation reference; it does not establish predictive performance or proper financial validation by itself.
records.next_step: Create rolling-origin benchmark exercises and pair them with residual diagnostics.

records.title: scikit-learn — Common Pitfalls and Recommended Practices
records.observation: The preprocessing example demonstrates leakage when transforms learn from test data and shows the role of pipelines.
records.limitation: Its generic example is not a sufficient time-series validation design for overlapping financial labels.
records.next_step: Pair preprocessing controls with time-aware splits, overlap handling and an untouched holdout.

records.title: arch — Univariate Volatility Modeling
records.observation: The examples include GARCH, GJR-GARCH, TARCH and Student-t errors, providing a more specific implementation anchor than a general statistics text.
records.limitation: In-sample likelihood examples do not prove out-of-sample volatility forecasting superiority.
records.next_step: Compare matched-horizon forecasts against simple baselines with a predeclared loss function.

records.title: Longstaff and Schwartz — Valuing American Options by Simulation: A Simple Least-Squares Approach
records.observation: The journal record identifies volume 14, issue 1 (2001), pages 113–147, and continuation-value regression. The webpage also shows a later online posting date.
records.limitation: Full text was not reviewed; do not substitute the webpage posting date for the original publication year.
records.next_step: Obtain an authorized full-text route and design independent training/evaluation and tree-benchmark exercises.

records.title: Demeterfi, Derman, Kamal and Zou — Volatility Swaps research note
records.observation: A direct paper route was located; its summary explicitly discusses unavailable strikes, jumps and volatility-of-volatility effects.
records.limitation: The complete derivations and implementation conventions remain to be reviewed.
records.next_step: Map replication assumptions to a finite-strike, jump-sensitive original lab.

records.title: Cboe — Selected Broad-Based Index, Equity and ETF Volatility Indices Methodology
records.observation: A direct methodology PDF was located beyond the supplied governance-directory anchor.
records.limitation: The complete methodology, revision history and exact applicable VIX sections have not been validated.
records.next_step: Read the full methodology and reproduce a documented calculation before publishing a VIX lab.

records.title: BIS — The equity market turbulence of 5 February: the role of exchange-traded volatility products
records.observation: The March 2018 analysis discusses leveraged/inverse volatility ETP rebalancing, feedback and spillovers. The page notes a graph correction.
records.limitation: A historical explanatory analysis is not a complete causal identification of every trade or a future trading signal.
records.next_step: Build a standalone 2018 case timeline and compare source claims with product terms and observable cash/risk mechanics.

records.title: Burkovska et al. — Calibration to American Options: Numerical Investigation of the de-Americanization
records.observation: The authors investigate de-Americanization calibration error and report that simplifying assumptions can produce large errors in some cases.
records.limitation: Only metadata and abstract were reviewed; no independent reproduction or endorsement of a calibration method is claimed.
records.next_step: Read the numerical setup and assess an explicit exercise-style calibration competency within the existing surface/model modules.

records.title: Cboe — BuyWrite Indices Methodology
records.observation: A direct benchmark-methodology candidate was located for benchmark reconstruction.
records.limitation: No methodology, cost assumption, total-return convention or historical result has been verified in this pass.
records.next_step: Review methodology and return conventions; assess replication and implementation-shortfall exercises without adopting promotional performance claims.

records.title: yfinance — Maintainer Repository
records.observation: The README separates the tool from Yahoo's data rights, directs users to Yahoo's terms and describes the API as intended for personal use.
records.limitation: The software license does not establish permission to host or redistribute market data. No provider terms or historical-chain completeness audit is complete.
records.next_step: Keep candidate use limited to separately reviewed learning workflows; evaluate licensed or synthetic public exercise data.

records.title: NSE — Equity Derivatives Contract Specifications
records.observation: The page includes product-specific expiry language, holiday adjustments and a link to NSE/FAOP/68747.
records.limitation: Current daily listings and the entire circular transition chain have not been reconciled. This is not a frozen contract master.
records.next_step: Check the linked circular and effective-date transitions, then map current versus historical contract examples.

records.title: SEBI — Safer participation of retail investors in Algorithmic trading
records.observation: The February 4, 2025 circular is identified as SEBI/HO/MIRSD/MIRSD-PoD/P/CIR/2025/0000013.
records.limitation: The original notice alone does not establish current implementation dates or all exchange/broker operational conditions.
records.next_step: Review the original text together with later notices and exchange implementation standards.

records.title: SEBI — Extension of timeline for retail algorithmic trading implementation
records.observation: The September 30, 2025 notice contains phased milestones and an April 1, 2026 implementation provision in the retrieved excerpt.
records.limitation: Subsequent changes and detailed exchange operational standards still require review.
records.next_step: Build a supersession/implementation chain instead of treating the first circular's date as final.

records.title: NSE Clearing — Settlement Mechanism
records.observation: The retrieved overview, labeled updated September 27, 2023, includes broad cash-exercise-settlement wording under index and individual-securities options. This requires reconciliation with specific physical-delivery circulars.
records.limitation: Do not use this overview alone to assert current stock-derivative settlement. An official host and a recent access date do not resolve conflicting scope.
records.next_step: Review current consolidated clearing circulars, product terms and SEBI's operative physical-settlement requirements.

records.title: SEBI — Physical settlement of stock derivatives, December 31, 2018
records.observation: The retrieved circular text mandates physical settlement for stock derivatives and gives a phased transition during 2019.
records.limitation: This historical circular alone is not a complete current operational manual or amendment review.
records.next_step: Follow the February 8, 2019 circular and current clearing rules to resolve Q027's overview conflict.

records.title: SEBI — Physical settlement of stock derivatives, February 8, 2019
records.observation: The official record identifies circular SEBI/HO/MRD/DOP1/CIR/P/2019/28 as a follow-up source.
records.limitation: Attachment content was not reviewed in this pass.
records.next_step: Read the operative provisions and trace later consolidated rules.
